      I’ve heard there’s some concerns with Russian ownership of the code

      Not only Russian ownership, but also plain dickheaded abuse of AGPL to try and claim "open-source" while prohibiting forks. Essentially, they added terms to their AGPL license mandating that any redistribution retains the OnlyOffice name and logo while also explicitly declining any redistributions the right to use OnlyOffice trademarks. "You must use our trademarks and you are not allowed to use our trademarks." They tried to exercise that stupid trap to block Euro-Office from forking it, but ultimately failed because AGPL says it cannot be restricted in that way.
